eps.o: The SuperKitties must figure out why someone is stealing all the yarn in Kittydale.
Lab Rat invents a giant boot to smush all the flowers at the Kittydale Flower Festival.
Mr. Puppypaws steals all of Kittydale’s fireworks.
The SuperKitties have to stop Lab Rat from turning Kittydale into cheese.
Zsa-Zsa takes away the Singing Squirrels' voices before a concert.
The SuperKitties have to stop Cat Burglar after he takes a gold statue from the Kittydale Museum.
SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.
The SuperKitties stop Zsa-Zsa from turning the Kittydale water tower into her own giant bubble bath.
The SuperKitties stop Lab Rat after she kicks all the groundhogs out of their special space.
On Kittydale Day, Zsa-Zsa uses a spray to make everyone in Kittydale act like birds.
Zsa-Zsa steals all the blueberries at the blueberry festival for her special cream.
It's Bitsy's first snow day, and the team must stop Lab Rat from zapping away all the snow.
Tennis balls fly menacingly across a park in Kittydale.
Zsa Zsa's minions steal a mini car from Peanut's master.
Mr. Puppypaws snatches Bitsy's favorite toy.
When the abandoned piano Cat Burglar is playing suddenly gets damaged, he takes one from two musicians who are about to perform on stage.
All the pet food in Kittydale is replaced with dog food.
Lab Rat tries to rid the city of its feline inhabitants by using a device similar to a laser pointer which cats are unable to resist.
The dogs in Kittydale are having their toys stealthily taken away.
A power outage suddenly occurs in the city.
Robots, disguised as kids' toys, steal cheese in Kittydale.
When Mr. Puppypaws' fetching stick is snubbed by other dogs who see another one, he attempts to make a better stick with wood from the park.
Lab Rat thinks the Moon is made of cheese, thus she attempts to hijack a soon-to-be departing rocket headed there.
The Superkitties are summoned to protect a new artifact at the museum.
Mr. Puppypaws digs holes at a park, causing tremors that terrify some underground animals.
Sparks makes his flying gadget move faster than Bitsy, thus his comrade feels she has lost her value for the team.
Zsa Zsa takes control of every mobile phone in Kittydale so everyone in town will watch her music video over and over.
Pickles makes up false emergencies so the SuperKitties will come to his picnic.
Platformed houses and stands for cats in Kittydale are being taken in the blink of an eye.
Mr. Puppypaws wants to have the Singing Squirrels to himself after hearing them rehearse but getting bothered by outside noises.
The locals of Kittydale are most surprised when what looks like Sparks goes on a robbing spree in town.
Mr. Puppypaws lures most of the other dogs away from the park so he and Ms. Poochytail can have the place to themselves.
The animals of Kittydale are getting their voices replaced by musical instrument sounds upon being exposed to Zsa Zsa's new spray.
Buddy and Sparks fall out over a game disagreement, thus the SuperKitties struggle to stop Lab Rat's scheme.
Sparks is afraid to ride his Super Kitty Kit after being knocked off of it from a great height.
Bitsy eats too much cat treats, and develops a stomachache which significantly limits her actions when an emergency comes.
Buddy, out of fascination, dons Amara's head jewel before it suddenly goes missing.
After Buddy uses his signature roll move in a mission, he finds out his suit is damaged, thus preventing him from doing the move again.
The SuperKitties stop Zsa-Zsa from stealing all the oranges in Kittydale.
Bitsy wishes she has super strength like Buddy.
While trying to make copies of a pet treat using a high-tech device, Bitsy inadvertently makes copies of herself.
Zsa Zsa wants to visit a tropical island for vacation, but the place is too far to fly to under her own power.
Howloween treats go missing all over Kittydale, so the SuperKitties must track down the thief.
Bitsy learns to say goodbye to Renata and her robin babies when they have to fly away.
The SuperKitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from cheating in the talent contest.
When Cat Burglar steals Christmas gifts from all over Kittydale, the SuperKitties must recover the stolen presents - and Bitsy's kitty castle.
When Amara brings a lost puppy to the Purr 'N' Play, Bitsy wonders if there will be enough attention for her.
The SuperKitties must stop whoever stole Abraca Dan's magic tricks.
Mr. Puppypaws uses his glitter dragon to steal Valentine's Day cards.
When Ginny accidentally breaks a special gift of friendship that Bitsy gave her, she tries to hide the truth.
